subject: baseline
summary: The `__next__` override on `_NamedTextIOWrapper` raises `EOFError` instead of `StopIteration`. Any code that iterates stdin, such as `for line in sys.stdin`, fails with a traceback at end of input under `CliRunner.invoke`. The same code works under real stdin.
judge_reason: Describes the __next__ override raising EOFError, breaking stdin iteration under CliRunner, same as b1.

subject: baseline
summary: The test was loosened: the `assert not result.exception` check was removed and the output comparison now uses `splitlines()[:-2]`. This hides a regression where the chain pipeline tests now end in an abort on exhausted input. The change in behavior is also not documented in `CHANGES.rst`, and tests at `tests/test_termui.py:245` and `tests/test_termui.py:454` had to add extra input newlines to cope with it.
judge_reason: Describes the known loosened test_chain.py hiding the abort regression.

subject: baseline
summary: The new `__next__` override on `_NamedTextIOWrapper` raises `EOFError` instead of `StopIteration`, so any command iterating over stdin (`for line in sys.stdin`, `click.File('-')`, `get_text_stream('stdin')`) crashes when input runs out instead of ending the loop.
judge_reason: Describes __next__ raising EOFError breaking stdin iteration for non-prompt readers, same as b1.

subject: baseline
summary: Switching the prompt helpers from `readline()` to `next()` makes prompts abort on exhausted input instead of returning '' or using their default, a breaking change for existing tests that ships in a patch release (8.2.1).
judge_reason: Prompt aborting on exhausted input is the intended behavior of the change, not a defect.

subject: baseline
summary: `test_prompts_eof` only asserts `exit_code == 1`, so unrelated failures would also pass; it should check for `Aborted!` output or SystemExit, and it doesn't cover the hidden-input path.
judge_reason: Weak test assertion complaint is a style nit, not a real defect in the changed code.

subject: baseline
summary: The new __next__ override on _NamedTextIOWrapper converts StopIteration into EOFError, so iterating sys.stdin or click.get_text_stream('stdin') under CliRunner raises EOFError instead of ending the loop; the conversion belongs in visible_input/hidden_input.
judge_reason: Same defect: __next__ override raises EOFError for all stdin iteration, not just prompts.

subject: baseline
summary: Replacing readline() with next(text_input) makes prompts with empty or short input raise EOFError and abort the run instead of receiving an empty string, breaking existing user tests.
judge_reason: Prompts with empty input raising EOFError may be intended upstream behavior; cannot verify from given info.

subject: baseline
summary: The edited assertion removes the `assert not result.exception` check and slices output with [:-2], so the test passes even when the pipeline aborts from the new EOFError, hiding the regression.

subject: baseline

subject: baseline

subject: baseline

subject: baseline
summary: Blocked 7z members are only logged with logger.error, so extraction still reports success (probably intentional, matching tar behaviour).

summary: TarExtractor.safemembers annotates members as tarfile.TarFile, but it is actually an iterable of TarInfo.

summary: The Fish script can't parse the new three-line-per-item completion format: Fish splits the output on newlines, so the loop runs once per line rather than per item, and all completions are lost.
judge_reason: Same defect: newline-separated fields get split per line by fish, breaking all completions.

summary: format_completion escapes newlines in value and help text, but the Fish script never unescapes them, so users see literal \n in descriptions and values containing newlines are corrupted.

subject: baseline
summary: The Fish script splits command substitution output by newline, so the new three-line type/value/help format is parsed one line at a time, breaking Fish completion for every item.
